requiredBoundedFollowupChanges.minimalCorrection: Recognize actual in-scope assessment execution forms using the existing runtime encodings as a role independent of semantic membership. Allow a genuine curricularAtomic assessment to terminate its own competence path without duplicating its learner-facing parent or creating an extra ID. Preserve actual ordinary preparation, motivation reachability, atomicity, scope and directional route-order checks; exclude assessment-role nodes when checking for genuine ordinary preparation.
positiveCases: 5743 remains curricularAtomic, has the exact valid task, is accepted as an in-scope terminal and still has a real ordinary preparation path through546bf.
Existing practiceAssessment terminal behavior remains valid.
A scoped self-terminal does not require a fake self-edge or duplicate contains placement.
negativeCases: An ordinary curricular atom with no assessment execution form is not a terminal merely because it is an endpoint or its title mentions a test.
An out-of-scope assessment cannot close another PC.
An assessment cannot satisfy the ordinary-preparation-path check merely by zero-length self-reach.
Missing motivation, non-atomic terminal, backward role ordering and invalid task metadata still fail.
